description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand when the view is hovered over. It manages cursor state during hover and view disappearance.

classes.name: PointingHandCursorModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand on hover.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view content and manages cursor push/pop logic based on hovering state.

methods.name: pointingHandCursor
methods.description: An extension method to apply PointingHandCursorModifier to any view.
